finding.title: Authentication Issue
finding.description: The admin user's password hash was incorrect in the database, preventing login. The bcrypt hash format was incompatible with the current password verification library.
finding.resolution: Updated admin password hash using the correct bcrypt format. Admin can now login with username: admin, password: admin.

finding.title: Session Cookie Mismatch
finding.description: Frontend sometimes uses 'familybudget.sid' while backend expects 'connect.sid'. The hooks.server.ts file handles both formats for compatibility.
finding.resolution: Confirmed that the session middleware correctly handles both cookie formats. Authentication works with either cookie name.

finding.title: No Mock Data Found
finding.description: Checked both frontend component and service - no mock data present. All data comes from real API endpoints.
finding.resolution: No action needed - the implementation correctly uses real API data.
